synopsis.statement: This repository is a barebones WebSocket server and client implementation written in 100% Java, built on java.nio for a non-blocking, event-driven model similar to the WebSocket API for web browsers, implementing the RFC 6455 and RFC 7692 protocol versions.

shape.tree:
Java-WebSocket/
├── README.markdown              the project's readme, describing this WebSocket server/client library
├── LICENSE                      MIT license, referenced by the readme as governing everything in the repo
├── CHANGELOG.md
├── pom.xml                      Maven dependency descriptor for org.java-websocket:Java-WebSocket

├── autobahn reports/             Autobahn test suite report output, split into clients and servers
│   ├── clients/
│   └── servers/
└── src/
    ├── main/
    │   ├── java/org/java_websocket/
    │   │   ├── client/WebSocketClient.java   abstract class that connects to valid ws:// WebSocket servers; fires onOpen, onClose, onMessage, onError
    │   │   └── server/WebSocketServer.java   abstract class implementing the server side of the WebSocket Protocol over HTTP
    │   ├── java9/module-info.java
